title: Hamas-Mladenov Phase 2 Talks Postponed Over Hamas Weapons Surrender Demand
detail: Negotiations scheduled this week at El-Alamein, Egypt between Palestinian armed groups (led by Hamas) and UN envoy Nickolay Mladenov — the chief mediator for Trump's Board of Peace — were postponed on June 3, 2026. Disarmament of militant groups remains the central sticking point: Mladenov made formally launching Phase 2 of Trump's Gaza reconstruction plan conditional on weapons surrender, including personal firearms. Hamas has flatly refused to disarm, calling any such precondition tantamount to unconditional surrender. Talks are expected to resume the following week only if mediators make progress on a compromise formula. The stalled Phase 2 process leaves Gaza reconstruction planning in legal and political limbo, with only 0.5% of the 42 million tons of rubble cleared, vast majority of pledged donor funds not yet disbursed, and 77% of Gaza's population still facing acute food insecurity according to the UN.

media.caption: Hamas-Mladenov Phase 2 talks postponed as disarmament demand stymies progress — June 3, 2026

title: Gaza Reconstruction Has Barely Begun — Only 0.5% of Rubble Cleared as Iran War Diverts U.S. Focus
detail: As of June 3, 2026, Gaza's reconstruction under Trump's Board of Peace plan has effectively stalled. Reporting by The National found that only 0.5% of the estimated 42 million tons of rubble has been cleared since the October 11, 2025 ceasefire — more than seven months into the post-war period. The majority of pledged donor funds, including commitments made at the February 2026 Board of Peace inaugural meeting, have not yet been disbursed. The ongoing US-Israel war against Iran — now in its 97th day — has absorbed Washington's diplomatic bandwidth, deprioritizing Gaza Phase 2 negotiations. UN agencies report 77% of the Gaza population still faces acute food insecurity. Phase 2, which was supposed to transition Gaza toward economic recovery and political stabilization, remains dependent on Hamas agreeing to disarm — a condition Hamas categorically rejects. International reconstruction specialists warn that without immediate Phase 2 activation, the ceasefire framework risks collapse.

media.caption: Gaza reconstruction stalls as Iran war diverts focus from Trump's Board of Peace — June 3, 2026

title: IDF Kills PIJ Rocket-Launching Cell Commander Ahmed Abu Mughaysib in Southern Gaza
detail: The IDF announced on June 3, 2026 that it had killed Ahmed Abu Mughaysib, head of a Palestinian Islamic Jihad rocket-launching cell operating in southern Gaza. A separate overnight strike in central Gaza killed at least one Hamas operative. In a further incident, two people were killed in an IDF strike on a house in al-Maghazi refugee camp, per Hamas-affiliated media. The elimination of Abu Mughaysib continues Israel's sustained campaign of targeted killings against PIJ and Hamas military commanders during the October 2025 ceasefire period. IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir publicly stated on June 3 that there is 'no ceasefire for our forces' in Lebanon — underscoring that Israeli military operations continue across multiple fronts simultaneously.

media.caption: IDF kills PIJ rocket-cell commander Ahmed Abu Mughaysib in southern Gaza — June 3, 2026
